usage.outputShape: body.data[] (array of hotel-offers). Per item: body.data[].hotel.{name,hotelId,cityCode,latitude,longitude}, body.data[].available, body.data[].offers[].{id,checkInDate,checkOutDate,room.typeEstimated,price.{currency,total,base},policies.cancellations[]}
quirks: hotelIds query param is REQUIRED and must be Amadeus hotel IDs (8-char codes like MCLONGHM), NOT a city name or free text — there is no city-name search on this endpoint, so you must already have valid Amadeus hotel IDs (comma-separated for multiple).
checkInDate/checkOutDate use YYYY-MM-DD; offers reflect those dates.
Returned price currency follows the hotel's listing (e.g. GBP) even when currencyCode=USD is requested — do not assume the requested currency.
Results come straight from Amadeus; an empty data[] just means no availability for those hotelIds/dates, not an error.
usage.guide: Call GET https://stabletravel.dev/api/hotels/search with a required hotelIds query param set to one or more Amadeus hotel IDs (comma-separated, e.g. MCLONGHM), plus checkInDate and checkOutDate as YYYY-MM-DD, and optionally adults and currencyCode. This is a sync x402 paid call (~$0.032 USDC on Base) returning 200 with JSON. Read offers from body.data[]: each entry has the hotel under .hotel and bookable rates under .offers[] with .price.total and .price.currency (note the currency may differ from your requested currencyCode). You need valid Amadeus hotel IDs up front — this endpoint does not do city-name lookup, so source IDs from the service's hotel-list-by-city endpoint first if you only have a city.
